messages:
sarah: Heads up — experimenting with an "inflight suppression" idea for SLO alerts surfaced in the console. If multiple similar alerts hit within a short window, show a compact suppressed count instead of full fanout. buffer window = configurable. Thoughts?

mike: Love the idea. How do you plan to surface suppressed counts in the UI? Per-tenant badge or per-route? :eyes:

sarah: Per-route compact badge — badge shows "4 suppressed" and hover/expand shows recent samples. Backend change: notify payload includes suppress_count and suppression_window_ms and an optional suppression_hint string. Example API snippet: 

```
POST /internal/notify
{
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "sev": "high",
  "suppress_count": 4,
  "suppression_window_ms": 60000,
  "suppression_hint": "inflight-dedup"
}
```

olivia: :thinking: We need to be careful to not drop telemetry. For quality/regression detection we still need raw events sampled. We should keep 1% full retention for offline evals.

kevin: Agreed. We already have sampling plumbing on the ingest path. Proposal: add notify.sample_reason = "retain_for_evals" when an event is chosen for retention. Aggregates still sent for UI.

sarah: Good call. UX also needs to clearly differentiate "suppressed (automated dedupe)" vs "muted (user/tenant action)". Wording draft: "X similar alerts suppressed in last Y minutes" vs "Notifications muted by policy". Who owns final copy?

mike: devex should own strings. ping @devex for copy & accessibility check. Also we should expose a console filter: suppressed:true to inspect suppressed groups.

notify-bot: Deploy job queued for notify-service:deploy/2026-03-21T10:15Z :rocket:

olivia: One more API nit — keep fields optional for backward compatibility. Default suppress_count to 0 and suppression_window_ms absent. Console treats absent as no suppression.

sarah: Yep — opt-in fields only. I'll draft a short RFC covering: API fields, sampling plan (1% retention), console badge/hover UX, query filter, and a rollback path. If no objections by EOD I'll open the PRs for notify-service + console changes.

mike: +1

kevin: +1
